name: tencent-qq-chat
description: QQ Bot OpenAPI v2 service for sending C2C/group messages and normalizing incoming chat events.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/GetAcces.name: get-access-token
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/GetAcces.description: Fetch a QQ Bot OpenAPI access token.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/StartGat.name: start-gateway
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/StartGat.description: Start the QQ Bot WebSocket Gateway receive loop.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/StopGate.name: stop-gateway
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/StopGate.description: Stop the QQ Bot WebSocket Gateway receive loop.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/GetGatew.name: get-gateway-status
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/GetGatew.description: Return Gateway receiver status and buffered message counts.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/PollMess.name: poll-messages
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/PollMess.description: Poll received QQ message events buffered by the Gateway receiver.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/AckMessa.name: ack-message
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/AckMessa.description: Acknowledge and remove buffered received messages.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/SendC2CM.name: send-c2c-message
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/SendC2CM.description: Send a QQ C2C message through QQ Bot OpenAPI.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/SendGrou.name: send-group-message
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/SendGrou.description: Send a QQ group message through QQ Bot OpenAPI.

Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/Normaliz.name: normalize-event
Tencent_QQ_Chat.Tencent_QQ_Chat/Normaliz.description: Normalize an incoming QQ Bot event payload.
